title: Sharper weapons and damage types
changes: Every weapon is redrawn bigger with its own shape: leaf, wavy, crystal and broad blades, new guards, axe heads, bows and staff tops.
New damage types: Fire can set foes alight, Cold slows, Poison hurts over time, Faith smites the undead. Monsters are weak or resistant to some.
New weapons: Pilgrim's Sword (Faith), Ember Axe (Fire) and Thornbow (Poison). Some armour, shields and hats now resist elements.
Elemental weapons show their element in the hand and on every hit, richer at higher item levels.
